title: killMob primitive — live mineflayer-pvp combat
scenario: REAL merged killMob primitive (unmodified) over live deps: bot.nearestEntity search, mineflayer-pvp 1.3.2 attack/stop engagement (the root-override single-mineflayer tree), entity-gone confirmation, drop sweep. Three pigs summoned in the cam's field of view; wooden sword equipped.

evidence.onCamera: Actor visible full-frame under the oak; hunts and kills three pigs in sequence; drops auto-collected during combat (porkchops in final inventory).
evidence.pvpStopInvariant: pvp.stop() called on every exit path per the primitive's design — no leaked engagement between hunts (attempt N+1 starts clean).
evidence.honestFailure: Take 2 (kept in logs) ended with an honest TARGET_NOT_FOUND 'no pig within 48 blocks' when the third pig wandered out of search radius — the exact prose a deliberating LLM would read.

caveats: dropsCollected counter reads low when proximity pickup happens DURING combat (before the sweep window) — the inventory delta is the truth; adapter note for assembly.
shoot + waitForMobRemoved primitives from this PR are covered by their botless suites; killMob is the on-camera representative (hawkeye bow wiring deferred to assembly).
